group:paper-gaokao-2023-zhejiang-jan:clo.overview: 作者来到埃塞俄比亚的哈伦纳森林，看养蜂人 Ziyad 用火把和绳子爬上 20 米高的树取野蜜；他熏烟时遭蜂群攻击滑回地面，原来凉夏推迟了孵化，采得太早，只能等待时机。
group:paper-gaokao-2023-zhejiang-jan:clo.fullTranslationZh:
我出发走进哈伦纳森林时，太阳正开始西沉。我要去亲眼看一场独特的采蜜。在埃塞俄比亚东南部这里，手工雕刻的蜂箱被安放在树梢上。爬上去取蜜很难，而且常常很危险。
我跟着养蜂人 Ziyad 穿过一大片草地，然后走进茂密的丛林。Ziyad 开始做准备。他收集了几把潮湿的树叶，用绳子捆好，再点燃这一束叶子做成火把。接着，他把绳子一头系在腰上，另一头绕在树干上，开始往上爬。每隔几分钟，他就停下来把绳子沿树干往上挪一段。
终于，Ziyad 接近了离地约 20 米高的蜂箱。他坐在一根树枝上，一点点朝蜂箱挪过去，把火把的烟吹进蜂箱上的一个小洞。突然，Ziyad 发出一声尖叫。几秒钟之内，他就顺着树干滑了下来，回到了地面。
现在采蜜还太早。凉爽的夏天推迟了孵化。幼蜂还在蜂巢里。成年蜜蜂被激怒了，在 Ziyad 从树上逃下来时一直攻击他。他只好等待合适的时机再爬上去。

theme.text: 在高高的树梢取野蜜又难又险，还得等对时机，即 Reaching them to get the honey is difficult。
theme.quote: Reaching them to get the honey is difficult

paragraphs.text: 作者进入哈伦纳森林，去看在树梢取蜜这件难而险的事。
跟着 Ziyad 进林，他做好火把，系上绳子一步步往树上爬。
终于接近蜂箱，他熏烟时突然惨叫，几秒内滑回地面。
原来采得太早，幼蜂未出、蜂群发怒，只能等合适时机。

mainLine.emotion: 期待→紧张→惊吓→无奈等待

selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 接着，他把绳子一头系在腰上，另一头绕在树干上，开始往上爬。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干在句末：Ziyad began climbing，Ziyad 开始爬树。前面的 with 结构交代他爬树时的状态：with 后的宾语 one end of a rope 带着过去分词 tied to his waist，表示绳子一头“被系在”腰上；and 并列的 the other end around the trunk of a tree 省去了 tied，介词短语直接说另一头绕在树干上。读懂这个 with 结构，就明白绳子是一头连人、一头绕树，后面他才会每隔几分钟把绳子往上挪。

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: Reaching them to get the honey is difficult——and often __43__.
selectedLongSentences.displayText: Reaching them to get the honey is difficult——and often dangerous.
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 爬上去取蜜很难，而且常常很危险。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主语是动名词短语 Reaching them，them 指放在树梢上的蜂箱；to get the honey 是目的，说爬上去是为了取蜜。谓语 is 后接表语 difficult，破折号后 and often dangerous 补上第二个表语，often 说明危险时常发生。这句先点出全文的难和险，后文 Ziyad 爬树、被蜂攻击都是在印证它。

completedSourceTexts.text: The sun was beginning to sink as I set off into the Harenna Forest. I was on my way to witness a unique honey harvest. Here, in south-east Ethiopia, hand-carved beehives(蜂箱) are placed in the treetops. Reaching them to get the honey is difficult——and often dangerous.

I followed beekeeper Ziyad over a wide stretch of grassland before entering a thick jungle. Ziyad began preparations. He gathered handfuls of damp tree leaves, wrapped them with string, and lit the bunch to create a torch(火把). Then, with one end of a rope tied to his waist and the other end around the trunk of a tree, Ziyad began climbing. He stopped every few minutes to move the rope higher up the tree trunk.

Finally, Ziyad got close to the hive which was around 20 meters above the ground. Sitting on a branch, he inched towards it and blew smoke from his torch into a tiny hole in the hive. Suddenly, Ziyad let out a sharp cry. Within seconds, he’d slid down the trunk and was back on the ground.

It was too early to collect the honey. A cool summer had delayed hatching. Baby bees were still in the honeycombs(蜂巢). The adult bees were angry and kept attacking as Ziyad escaped from the tree. He had to wait for the right moment to go back up.
